notes.title: Hexpire Update V1.2 AKA Run Extension Update
notes.notes:
Hexpire Update V1.2 AKA Run Extension Update:

Bugs:

Building tiles disappearing bug is fixed
Nowhere to place building scenario fixed
Ordering issues fixed


Gameplay/content:

Added Lighthouse building


Polish/Balancing:

Wells make more water.
Increased field and house max water.
Changed Hexpack price increase from *1.5 to *1.2 + 50
Increased mine spawn rate

notes.title: Hexpire Demo Update
notes.notes:
Patch notes for Hexpire Demo V1.1

-Bug fixes:
    -Prevented extra building bug
    -Prevented extra hexagons bug
-New content:
    -Added Pyramid building
-Polish/Miscellaneous
    -Added more title screen openers
    -Added different colored productivity number for water producing buildings and money producing buildings
    -Edited City Hall ruleset
    -Edited Log Cabin ruleset
    -Added number pop up for amount of money made

And that updates Hexpire Demo V1.1!
